gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent Gliosarcoma; Recurrent Supratentorial Glioblastoma; Supratentorial Gliosarcoma
Participants must have histologically proven glioblastoma or gliosarcoma which is progressive or recurrent following radiation therapy +/- chemotherapy

candidate_evidence.quote: To determine the safety and tolerability of Akt/ERK Inhibitor ONC201 (ONC201) in combination with radiotherapy before a tumor resection in recurrent glioblastoma (GBM) patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: ONC201 and Radiation Therapy Before Surgery for the Treatment of Recurrent Glioblastoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the ability of ONC201 to inhibit Akt by evaluating progressive disease (PD) markers by immunohistochemistry such as Sox2, Oct3/4, Nanog, Akt and p-Akt, GSK3 and pGSK3alpha.
Changes in markers pre- and post- treatment will be assessed using paired t-tests or Wilcoxon signed rank test.

role_evidence.quote: This phase I trial studies the effects of ONC201 in combination with standard of care radiation therapy in treating patients with glioblastoma that has come back (recurrent).

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational imipridone; registered as Akt/ERK inhibitor ONC201 (TIC10)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Akt/ERK inhibition; may stop tumour growth by blocking enzymes needed for cell growth; decrease glioblastoma-initiating cells

source_quote.quote: To assess the ability of ONC201 to inhibit Akt by evaluating progressive disease (PD) markers by immunohistochemistry such as Sox2, Oct3/4, Nanog, Akt and p-Akt, GSK3 and pGSK3alpha.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: glioma stem cell markers (Sox2, Oct3/4, Nanog; RNA-Seq)

source_quote.quote: To determine the ability of ONC201 to decrease glioblastoma-initiating cells as determined by expression of glioma stem cells using ribonucleic acid-sequencing (RNA-Seq) of treated brain tumor tissues compared to non-treated brain tumor tissues.

Pre-treatment archival tumor tissue and post-treatment tumor tissue will be obtained to evaluate other molecular markers of response to ONC201 + RT, including pharmacodynamic markers such as DRD2 and DRD5.

coder_notes: Both registered arms are EXPERIMENTAL and both receive ONC201; Arm II receives no pre-operative ONC201 and its resected tissue serves as the non-treated comparison, so control_arm_from_other_arms is yes. ONC201 role is experimental in both arms (pre-op in Arm I, post-op only in Arm II). The record never states an INN, so active_moiety is the development code onc201. DRD2/DRD5 are coded candidate_matched because the record calls them pharmacodynamic markers of ONC201; the record itself describes ONC201 as an Akt/ERK inhibitor. No biomarker is an entry requirement. Radiotherapy and resection are not agents.
